title: Without Customers — View there is no Customers tab and archive gives a count
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data' but not 'Customers — View'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have two new customers for this test on tier A for work orders, made by an Admin, so tier A has customers.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  4. Open tier A's three-dot menu on the Tiers list.
  5. Click Archive.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page shows its Pricing tab.
  • It has no Customers tab.

Step 3:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 4:

  • The menu offers Archive.

Step 5:

  • The dialog reads "2 customers are on" tier A's name ". Someone who can manage customers moves them first."
  • It names no customer.
